verdict.rationale: LiveKit Cloud documents reverting an agent deployment to a previous version and instant rollback, which implies versioned deployments and covers the roll-back part of the story. Reviewing changes before deploying is not evidenced, and the only sources are pricing-page claims. Missing for 10: a documented review or diff workflow for agent changes, explicit version history or management docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
